era: 2019 duckduckgo.com: home page with the large Dax logo and DuckDuckGo wordmark centred over a square-cornered 590px search box on #f7f7f7, grey magnifier that turns into a green button once something is typed, tagline under the box; results page with a #fafafa header (36px round logo, 44px search box with 4px corners), Web / Images / Videos / News tabs in 600-weight grey with a 1px dark line under the current one, All Regions / Safe Search / Any Time filters, and results as a #00278e title, a favicon with the full green #20692b URL, then a #494949 snippet, all in Proxima Nova

sources.shows: results for 'social media trends' (Search Engine Watch, 'What's it like using DuckDuckGo in 2019?'): round logo, square-cornered search box with grey magnifier, Web (current, dark) Images Videos News tabs, All Regions / Safe Search: Moderate / Any Time filters, ad with sitelinks, results as blue title, favicon + green full URL, grey snippet with bold terms, sidebar ad

results for 'alternative to google search': Web Images Videos News | Software tabs with the current one underlined, software cards module, filters row, result with blue title, favicon + green URL and snippet

home page: large round Dax logo over the DuckDuckGo wordmark, centred square-cornered search box with grey magnifier, tagline 'The search engine that doesn't track you.' with a link, hamburger menu top right, 'Add DuckDuckGo to Chrome' balloon
home page capture: logo_homepage.normal.v108.svg logo and wordmark centred on #f7f7f7, search box, menu
